envelope.description: Add the exact-token title lookup to the tracker port

body.title: Add the exact-token title lookup to the tracker port
body.summary: Add findIssuesByTitleToken(token) to TrackerPort with a strict gh helper in github.ts, the GitHub adapter implementation and the in-memory fake. Matching is exact: the title equals the token or starts with it followed by an em dash and a space.
acceptanceChecks: STORY-<h>-s1 matches 'STORY-<h>-s1' and 'STORY-<h>-s1 — title' and not STORY-<h>-s10; TASK -t1 does not match -t10
a failed gh call is a failed result, never an empty list
the adapter and fake agree over a stubbed gh boundary

tests.name: src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/title-token.test.ts: the exact-token matcher accepts the token and the token followed by an em dash and not a longer id
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/title-token.test.ts: findIssuesByTitleToken in the GitHub adapter over a stubbed gh boundary and in the fake agree and a failed call is a failed result
